name: LangChain

name: LangGraph

not_ideal_for: Simple pipelines without branching or state

name: LlamaIndex
best_for: RAG pipelines and knowledge-augmented agents

name: AutoGen
best_for: Multi-agent conversations and research automation

name: CrewAI
best_for: Role-based multi-agent systems where agents have defined personas and goals

best_for: Enterprise .NET/C# agent development with plugin ecosystem

name: Haystack
best_for: Production RAG pipelines and document question answering

name: DSPy
best_for: Programmatic prompt optimization and pipeline compilation

name: PydanticAI
best_for: Type-safe agents with Pydantic validation of structured outputs

name: Agno
best_for: Fast model-agnostic agent development with built-in memory

name: smolagents
best_for: Lightweight code-first agents with minimal abstraction
not_ideal_for: Complex enterprise workflows requiring extensive tooling
